acceptanceCriteria: Each listed runner either uses the shared sanitized Git environment (GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1, GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1, system and global config isolated, empty credential helper) or carries a recorded reason it must inherit the caller's environment, with a test for each runner changed.
Every surprise status read uses the isolated shared implementation.
Configuration changes after loader completion cannot execute clean/process filters or alter repository state.
Dirty-worktree refusal and clean committed-range receipts retain their intended behavior.
body:
Found 2026-09-26 at 2961076f while following up the appflows runner review finding (V1-0254). Core and MCP reads use sanitizedGitEnvironment (internal/gokernel/repository.go) or boundedGitRunner (internal/liveverify/affected/dirty.go). These runners do not: internal/dogfoodflow/check.go:116 and internal/dogfoodflow/flow.go:142 (os.Environ plus LC_ALL=C), internal/lspprovider/provider.go:170 (inherited environment), internal/releasecandidate/candidate.go:292 (isolated config but no GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH), internal/tasks/store/release.go:208 (inherited environment). In a partial clone a missing object can be lazily fetched from the promisor remote, and user or system Git config (hooks, fsmonitor, credential helpers) applies. None of these are Core read verbs, so invariant 4 is not directly breached; V1-0349 covers the Core and MCP reads. Decide per runner whether to reuse the sanitized environment.

Audit addendum 2026-09-26 (SEC-03), source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a: After snapshot/build isolation has completed, touchsurprise.Render calls requireCleanWorktree, which executes raw git status against live repository metadata. This runner disables fsmonitor but does not use gitstatus.Status or neutralize repository clean/process filters. A metadata change between the isolated check and this second read can bypass the intended no-filter execution boundary. Static filter configuration is already rejected by the earlier loader: this is a concurrent-change defense gap, not a demonstrated ordinary-path command-execution issue.
Source: internal/touchsurprise/touchsurprise.go:43; internal/touchsurprise/git.go:51; internal/touchsurprise/git.go:97; cmd/corvint/surprise.go:120; internal/gitstatus/status.go:488; internal/contextindex/snapshot.go:649.
Verification: {"method": "Source inspection and existing regression tests only", "test": "TestSurpriseWritesNothing and TestSurpriseRefusesDirtyWorktree pass with ordinary fixture configuration. The existing surprise package has no filter/config-change regression.", "reproduction": "NOT_RUN: no command-running fixtures or metadata-race demonstrations executed."}
Correction: Route this status call through the shared gitstatus.Status isolation and preserve its safe refusal semantics; avoid a later raw status command with weaker boundaries.
See .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md and .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/ for original evidence. This addendum does not claim implementation or promotion.
title: Git runners outside the Core read path inherit the environment without GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH or config isolation
